name: axon-protocol
description: Decentralized agentic banking infrastructure on Stellar

scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:ts
scripts.build:ts: npm run build:sdk && npm run build --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:ts
scripts.test:ts: npm run build:sdk && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run lint:contracts && npm run lint:ts
scripts.lint:contracts: cargo fmt --manifest-path contracts/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path contracts/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.lint:ts: npm run build:sdk && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
